newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Sigma Koki to take over Chinese venture.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Sigma Koki to take over Chinese venture.

text.p: Japanese laser equipment maker Sigma Koki Co Ltd said on Thursday that it will make its laser optical equipment joint venture in China a wholly owned subsidiary in December.
The joint venture, Shanghai Sigma Koki Co Ltd, is currently 80 percent held by Sigma and the rest by a local Chinese firm.
Sigma will pay the Chinese firm $90,000 for the stake, and then boost the subsidiary's capitalisation from the current $450,000 to $2 million.
Sigma also plans to build a new factory to make lens for laser equipment outside of Shanghai, the company said in a statement.
